title: 국립대학법인 인천대학교 설립ㆍ운영에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.text_en: Ministry of Education ( National University Support Division ), 044-203-6918

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「국립대학법인 인천대학교 설립ㆍ운영에 관한 법률 시행령」에서 위임한 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Incheon National University Corporation and matters necessary for its implementation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(정의) 이 규칙에서 사용하는 용어의 뜻은 다음과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Definitions) The meanings of terms used in this Rule are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. “자금”이란 현금, 예금, 수표 및 우편환(郵便換) 등을 말한다.
rows.text_en: 1. “Funds” means cash, deposits, checks, and postal money orders, etc.
2. “End of previous fiscal year” refers to the last day of the previous fiscal year.
3. “End of period” refers to the last day of the relevant fiscal year.
4. “Current period” refers to the relevant fiscal year.

rows.source_ko: 5. “적립금”이란 특정한 경영목적을 달성하기 위하여 예치하는 자금으로서 기금 등에 대응하는 적립액을 말한다.
rows.text_en: 5. “Reserve fund” refers to funds deposited to achieve specific management objectives, and refers to the reserve amount corresponding to a fund, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(예산부속명세서) 「국립대학법인 인천대학교 설립ㆍ운영에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제11조의2제1항에서 “등록금 명세서, 인건비 명세서 등 교육부령으로 정하는 예산부속명세서”란 다음 각 호의 명세서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Statements of Budget Subsidiaries) In Article 11-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Incheon National University (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”),the term “statements of tuition fees, statements of personnel expenses, etc., prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Education” refers to the statements of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 별지 제1호서식에 따른 전기말 추정 미수금 명세서
rows.text_en: 1. Statement of Estimated Accounts Receivable at the End of the Previous Period in accordance with Form No. 1

rows.source_ko: 2. 별지 제2호서식에 따른 전기말 추정 차입금 명세서
rows.text_en: 2. Statement of estimated borrowings at the end of the previous period pursuant to Form No. 2
3. Tuition Fee Statement in accordance with Form No. 3
4. Statement of personnel expenses pursuant to Form No. 4
5. Other necessary specifications

rows.source_ko: 제4조(결산부속명세서) 영 제11조의3제1항에서 “받을 어음 명세서, 유형고정자산 명세서 등 교육부령으로 정하는 결산부속명세서”란 다음 각 호의 명세서를 말한다. <개정 2019. 9. 17.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Supplementary Schedules to Settlement of Accounts) In Article 11-3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “supplementary schedules to settlement of accounts prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Education, such as statements of bills receivable and statements of tangible fixed assets” refers to the schedules set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Sep. 17, 2019>
1. Supplementary schedule to the balance sheet pursuant to Article 5
2. Supplementary details for the statement of operations pursuant to Article 6

rows.source_ko: 제5조(재무상태표 부속명세서) 재무상태표 부속명세서는 다음 각 호의 명세서로 한다. <개정 2019. 9. 17.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Statements Supplementary to the Statement of Financial Position) The statements supplementary to the statement of financial position shall be the statements set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Sep. 17, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 별지 제5호서식에 따른 현금 및 예금 명세서
rows.text_en: 1. Statement of cash and deposits pursuant to Form No. 5

rows.source_ko: 2. 별지 제6호서식에 따른 수표 출납 명세서
rows.text_en: 2. Check disbursement statement pursuant to Form No. 6

rows.source_ko: 3. 별지 제7호서식에 따른 선급금(先給金) 명세서
rows.text_en: 3. Statement of Advance Payments in accordance with Form No. 7

rows.source_ko: 4. 별지 제8호서식에 따른 가지급금(假支給金) 명세서
rows.text_en: 4. Statement of Advance Payments in accordance with Form No. 8

rows.source_ko: 5. 별지 제9호서식에 따른 선급(先給) 법인세 명세서
rows.text_en: 5. Statement of Prepaid Corporate Income Tax pursuant to Form No. 9

rows.source_ko: 6. 별지 제10호서식에 따른 받을 어음 명세서
rows.text_en: 6. Statement of Bills Receivable pursuant to Form No. 10

rows.source_ko: 7. 별지 제11호서식에 따른 투자와 기타자산 명세서
rows.text_en: 7. Statement of Investments and Other Assets pursuant to Form No. 11
8. Statement of investment securities pursuant to Form No. 12
9. Statement of Tangible Fixed Assets in accordance with Form No. 13
10. Statement of Intangible Fixed Assets pursuant to Form No. 14

rows.source_ko: 11. 별지 제15호서식에 따른 단기(장기) 차입금 명세서
rows.text_en: 11. Statement of Short-term (Long-term) Borrowings in accordance with Form No. 15
12. Statement of Unpaid Amounts in accordance with Form No. 16

rows.source_ko: 13. 별지 제17호서식에 따른 가수금(假受金) 명세서
rows.text_en: 13. Statement of Suspense Receipts in accordance with Form No. 17

rows.source_ko: 14. 별지 제18호서식에 따른 지급 어음 명세서
rows.text_en: 14. Statement of Bills of Payment in accordance with Form No. 18

rows.source_ko: 15. 별지 제19호서식에 따른 어음 출납 명세서
rows.text_en: 15. Statement of Bill Disbursement in accordance with Form No. 19

rows.source_ko: 16. 별지 제20호서식에 따른 차관(외화 장기차입금) 명세서
rows.text_en: 16. Statement of Loans (Long-term Foreign Currency Borrowings) pursuant to Form No. 20
17. Statement of school bonds pursuant to Form No. 21
18. Statement of accumulated funds pursuant to Form No. 22
19. Other necessary specifications
[Title amended Sep. 17, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(운영계산서 부속명세서) 운영계산서 부속명세서는 다음 각 호의 명세서로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Statements Supplementary to the Statement of Operations) The statements supplementary to the statement of operations shall be the specifications of each of the following subparagraphs.
1. Tuition fee statement according to Form No. 3
2. Statement of transfer payments pursuant to Form No. 23

rows.source_ko: 3. 별지 제24호서식에 따른 예비비 사용액 명세서
rows.text_en: 3. Statement of Reserve Fund Usage According to Form No. 24

rows.source_ko: 4. 별지 제25호서식에 따른 고정자산 감가상각비 명세서
rows.text_en: 4. Statement of Depreciation Expenses for Fixed Assets in accordance with Form No. 25
5. Other necessary specifications
ADDENDA <Ministry of Education Decree No. 38, July 1, 2014>
This rule shall take effect on July 1, 2014.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <교육부령 제188호, 2019. 9. 17.> (어려운 법령용어 정비를 위한 26개 법령의 일부개정에 관한 교육부령)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Education Decree No. 188, Sep. 17, 2019> (Ministry of Education Decree on the Partial Amendment of 26 Laws for the Standardization of Difficult Legal Terminology)
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <교육부령 제240호, 2021. 6. 30.> (어려운 법령용어 정비를 위한 11개 법령의 일부개정에 관한 교육부령)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Education Decree No. 240, June 30, 2021> (Ministry of Education Decree on the Partial Amendment of 11 Laws for the Standardization of Difficult Legal Terms)
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
